'''Ronith Blario''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who was a [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] for the [[Resistance]] [[Resistance navy|fleet]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> He was a reckless rookie who flew an [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor]].<ref name="FFG">{{FFGXW2|set=Hotshots and Aces Reinforcements Pack|cardname=Ronith Blario}}</ref> He shared the last name with another Resistance [[pilot]] named [[Ataphen Blario]].<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
Ronith Blario wore a [[Color|green]] [[flight suit]] with a white vest, a [[FreiTek Incorporated|FreiTek]] [[life support]] unit, a gray [[Guidenhauser]] [[flight harness]], and gray [[glove]]s. He wore a red [[flight helmet]], with a black and yellow checkered pattern on top.<ref name="TLJVD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ronith Blario first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
